enrichment-abilities.json.name: Ancestral Fortune
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Once per turn, spend 1YP to change one Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw made for this model to an unmodified 6; the change applies to a single roll, not all rolls of that kind. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Luck Has. Need Keeps. Toil Earns.
Prioritised Efficiency
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Approximates Hostile Acquisition state: +1 to hit targeting enemy near objectives, reroll charge. Both yield-point states share +1 hit; objective proximity assumed met (hill-climbing mode).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Outflanking Armour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Selects up to two friendly SAGITAUR units to make an ingress move; the requirements that they be in Strategic Reserves and that this be used at the end of the opponent's Movement phase from the second battle round onwards are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fury of the Hearth
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The +1 S on ranged attacks is unconditional; the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] grant is optional (only if you spend 1 YP). The resource-spend and keyword-grant steps together model that opt-in upgrade, but the sequence does not express that only the Sustained Hits step is gated on the YP spend. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Optimal Application
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] YP gain is 1 per controlled objective outside your deployment zone with an IRON-MASTER/MEMNYR STRATEGIST model within range (max 2 YP/turn); the model-proximity, deployment-zone exclusion, and 2 YP cap are not encoded. The Shooting-phase effect (optionally spend 1 YP so a selected BRÔKHYR/IRONKIN STEELJACKS/ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1) has its unit gating simplified. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Ruthless Reinvestment
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of the battle LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have the Hostile Acquisition ability; at the end of the Command phase you can spend 3 YP to swap the army between Hostile Acquisition and Fortify Takeover (the optional toggle is modeled as an opaque grant). The clause that units have neither ability except as described by this rule is not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Oathbound Speculator
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored; permanent re-roll of Wound rolls of 1 for the bearer's unit, plus an optional 3YP spend each time the unit is selected to shoot or fight for +1 to Wound roll until end of phase.
